title: 66:9 bring to the birth . . . shut the womb. In the natural world, once a woman comes to the point of travail, where labor has begun and the baby is ready to be born, the baby is indeed brought forth. The Lord does not at that point "shut the womb." In the same way, he will not cause Zion to come to the point of giving birth to her children of righteousness and then shut the womb. The birth of the children of Zion is as certain as the birth of any infant.
author: Tina M. Peterson
